scope: Final-IFF native court geometry, UVs, material depth state and decoded packaged DDS pixels only.

checks.check: One named continuous court model in final IFF
Every decoded court vertex is at exact game Y=0
Ground model/material/effect has no nonzero depth bias
NBA yellow boundary UVs agree within 3 mm
DDS yellow transition is present at all arc/corner samples within two texel diagonals
No pale free-throw arc pixels 1.5–16 cm inside either black-key endpoint
Reference-end faint semicircle follows the corrected black-key front plane
Reference end retains four separate packaged white lane tabs per side
Packaged A apex faces negative source X toward the reference basket
Packaged hoop-back apron is dark paint
Packaged top apron contains both black and white brush continuation
Packaged bottom apron contains both black and white brush continuation
Packaged outside-fence stone is warm mid-grey, not pale blank apron
Packaged sideline/baseline centers match the gameplay rectangle
Open-end packaged three-point/key/free-throw lines have distinct white pixels at intended positions
Open-end functional line UV position agrees within 3 mm
Open-end 5.08cm white stroke outer edges match within two texel diagonals
Final DDS open-end cement is mid-grey with useful white-line contrast
Final DDS adjoining garden paving also remains grey
Final DDS outer guard uses the new grey base
Packaged grey cement retains subtle nonuniform mineral texture

floor.evidence_image_note: Crops are decoded final DDS pixels resized to the physical world XY aspect ratio; no source SVG pixels are substituted.

limitations: Bilinear top-mip G-B=50 identifies a colour transition, not engine scoring or native line alpha.
Texture compression/filtering produces pixel-scale uncertainty beyond the numeric UV error.
Game lighting, live animation, actual loaded texture precedence and gameplay are not evaluated.
Photo reconstruction dimensions and colour samples are not calibrated site measurements.
